ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: "SUPERVISED RESEARCH EXPERIENCE." This course makes particular use of the unique library collections and archives at the University of Cambridge to provide undergraduate students with an opportunity to pursue a research or performance project of their choosing. Students will be guided in selecting a topic, identifying primary and secondary materials, outlining an argument, and constructing a scholarly paper. Supervision will be provided jointly by the faculty director of the Cambridge Summer Music Residency and a Cambridge-based scholar. This course culminates with participation in the Cambridge Summer Residency taking place July 11- August 5, 2022.
